MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The waterproof wire connectors fit my earlier purchase of insulated electrical connectors because they offer another practical way to join and protect wires during repairs.",
    "The epoxy fits my purchases of strong tape and vinyl cement because securing and repairing materials is a recurring need, provided the adhesive suits the materials involved."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Pocket-hole screws and carbide inserts assume woodworking or machining tasks that my purchases have not established.",
    "Large heat-shrink tubing, heavy battery cable terminals, and packs of identical nylon nuts require particular dimensions or applications; their general connection to repairs does not make them useful to me now.",
    "Steel wool and a feeler gauge could be useful for particular jobs, but I have no immediate surface-preparation or clearance-measuring task."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical repairs seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "Buying wire connectors seems to have been taken as a reason to offer electrical parts with very different sizes and applications."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific size, material compatibility, and purpose matter more to me than whether something broadly belongs among repair supplies.",
    "An item can fit my interests without being something I would choose now: the mixed fastener assortment is relevant, but I would wait until I need particular sizes.",
    "My history spans several years, so an older connector or adhesive purchase does not establish that the same project is still active."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but too often assume a specific current project or equipment need from a loosely related past purchase."
}
